mapper.insert: insert into mem_config_sync_batch (tenant_id, source_dept_id, sync_type, preview_version, status, idempotency_key, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{tenantId}, #{sourceDeptId}, #{syncType}, #{previewVersion}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})

insert into mem_config_sync_detail (batch_id, tenant_id, target_dept_id, target_period_id, business_key, source_record_id, target_record_id, operation, decision, source_snapshot, target_snapshot, diff_snapshot, source_row_version, target_row_version, result_status, create_time) values (#{batchId}, #{tenantId}, #{targetDeptId}, #{targetPeriodId}, #{businessKey}, #{sourceRecordId}, #{targetRecordId}, #{operation}, #{decision}, #{sourceSnapshot}, #{targetSnapshot}, #{diffSnapshot}, #{sourceRowVersion}, #{targetRowVersion}, #{resultStatus}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select * from mem_config_sync_batch where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and batch_id = #{batchId}
mapper.update: update mem_config_sync_detail set result_status = #{resultStatus}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, target_record_id = #{targetRecordId}, result_time = sysdate() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and batch_id = #{batchId} and detail_id = #{detailId}
